serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: Dinner is ready! 
You: Oh wow, it smells great.
Bot: Today I made a fried sausage with onions. Enjoy!
You: It looks great. How did you make it?
Bot: I cut marks on the sausage, put it on a pan and fried it until the skin became nice and crispy. Then I cut the pickled onions and added them to the pan. I waited a few minutes until the onions caramelized and that’s it!  
You: I wonder how it tastes…
